Regression test tests/test_wait_bounded.py::test_an_expired_lease_wait_is_refused_not_nothing_to_retry asserts exit==O.REFUSED and now passes.

No duplicate work: Be68798098a is the item-wait exit-code bug; the any-wait expired-lease sleep regression is a separate already-red test, not this fix.
